prompt: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a full shot frames a barefoot woman with long dark curly hair in a flowing red dress with thin straps and a long pleated skirt. The camera holds a static shot as she raises both arms above her head and begins to spin on the ball of one foot. The skirt of the dress lifts and flares out into a wide circle around her legs, and her hair swings outward with each turn. After three fast turns she slows, lowers her arms in a smooth arc and stops facing the camera, her chest rising and falling as the dress settles around her knees. Shown as a 2x2 grid of the same image: top left on a plain flat medium-gray (#808080) background, top right on a plain white background, bottom left on a plain black background, bottom right its grayscale alpha matte, white subject on black.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, a medium close-up frames a gray tabby cat with green eyes, white whiskers and a striped tail crouching low, its eyes fixed on a feather toy with blue and purple feathers on a short wand that twitches just in front of it. The camera holds a static shot as the cat wiggles its hindquarters and its tail tip flicks back and forth. It springs forward with both front paws stretched out and pins the feathers down, then rolls onto its side, wraps its front legs around the toy and kicks at it with its back legs, its ears flattening. Shown as a 2x2 grid of the same image: top left on a plain flat medium-gray (#808080) background, top right on a plain white background, bottom left on a plain black background, bottom right its grayscale alpha matte, white subject on black.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, a close-up frames a clean white ceramic cup with a thin rounded handle on a matching white saucer. The camera arcs around the cup with small amplitude at slow speed as a stream of dark hot coffee pours into it from the curved spout of a silver pot held just above the frame. The coffee swirls and rises in the cup, a light brown foam forms and spins on its surface, and thin wisps of steam curl up from it. The stream thins and stops, and a last drop falls from the spout and sends a small ring across the full cup. Shown as a 2x2 grid of the same image: top left on a plain flat medium-gray (#808080) background, top right on a plain white background, bottom left on a plain black background, bottom right its grayscale alpha matte, white subject on black.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, a close-up frames a single tall white wax candle burning in a polished brass holder, a small puddle of clear melted wax around its black wick. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the flame. The flame stretches tall and thin, then bends and flickers sideways, and a thin line of gray smoke rises and twists above it. A drop of melted wax slides down the side of the candle and hardens near the base as the flame steadies and burns upright again, its blue core glowing beneath the yellow tip. Shown as a 2x2 grid of the same image: top left on a plain flat medium-gray (#808080) background, top right on a plain white background, bottom left on a plain black background, bottom right its grayscale alpha matte, white subject on black.
